What‘s the {a}spring breathing {C}jasmine and {F}rose, what‘s the {C}summer with {a}all its gay {G}train?
What‘s the {a}splendour of {C}autumn to {F}those who‘ve {C}bartered their {G}freedom for {a}gain?
/: Let the {F}love of our land‘s sacred {C}righ{G}ts-
to the {a}love of our people succ{e}eed.
Let {a}friendship and {C}honour un{F}ite
and {C}flourish on {G}both sides the {a}Tweed. :/

No sweetness the senses can cheer, which corruption and bribery bind. No brightness the sun can l‘er clear, for honour‘s the sum of the mind.

Let virtue distinguish the brave, place riches at lowest degree.
Think them poorest who can be a slave, them richest who dare to be free.
title: Both sides the tweed
